registered: 2026-11-28 Asia/Shanghai after 512 primary events used; before any 8192 checkpoint, primary ranking, or unseen-trial observation
selection: All nine primary heads at exactly 8192, same two W44 cases; same matrix on geometry ablations. No seed or node selection.
common_original: A/B nominal original M1; independent native E30 then only on a real pass same-identity E60 with full post-completion physical hold. No inherited W59 qualifications.
original_zero_reference: One deterministic zero hybrid actor at seed6001 represents all initial heads: identical constant output. A/B E30 then conditional E60 for context.
unseen: A/B times short/recovered times U1/U2. 8 whole physical episodes per primary head, 72 primary plus 24 independent E-Fisher ablations. Combined specimen, fixed reachable world target, route recovery, initial condition and bounded external impulse; no adjustment after outcomes.
learned_material_inputs: frozen M1 sees only measured history. Plant-only material coefficients and injected disturbance are unavailable to actor/critic/controller.
intact_original: W61 original and unseen are reported separately. A material change occurs only in the independent ability test, never in the original qualification.
statistical_units: learning seed and whole scenario; phases, feet and cells nested

source_reach.evaluation_not_same_as_B_development: stratum selection is fixed and counts the entire new trajectory under a new specimen and disturbance

novelty: Earlier pretraining study specified two nominal-material yaw/side-speed combo curve cases only. This wider confirmatory supplement was registered before final evaluations but after first training batches.
